gap: No result ChatGPT got states a measured delivered capacity or a measured PPS current limit for these banks: Techtest.org measured 34.7–35.2 Wh (94–95% of rated) from the INIU Carry P55L-E2 against 27.4–31.5 Wh (74–85%) from the Anker Nano A1638, and found the INIU's built-in cable limited to 3 A PPS while the Anker's cable offers 5 A.
standout_why: Compared against TalkAndroid (cited), Pickstead, Pack Hacker's A1638 review and ChargerLAB's UGREEN teardown. TalkAndroid's figures are all maker claims or list prices, and it says the brands' claims are unverified. Pickstead says its bank 'was not charged or drained here' and covers the A1259 and Zolo, not the A1638. ChatGPT's own answer says sustained output for the INIU is unverified and tells Samsung owners to check PPS themselves; it mentions Anker throttling only as 'reviewers noted'. No page read has delivered Wh or per-cable PPS amps. Not a 3 because TechRadar's roundup and A1638 review bodies would not load (they may hold the throttling note), and because the INIU that Techtest measured is the Carry P55L-E2, not the Pawsible Slim P41L-E2 that ChatGPT picked.
decides: Confirms INIU as the value pick on measured capacity: the Carry P55L-E2 delivered about 11–18% more energy than the Anker A1638 in Techtest's runs, and it is $26.99 at INIU's store today. Reverses ChatGPT's Samsung advice: the measured INIU cable tops out at 11 V / 3 A PPS (33 W), short of the 10 V / 4.5 A that Samsung's 45 W mode needs, and 4.5 A is only on its USB-C port. The Anker Nano A1638, which we link, is the only candidate with a measured 5 A PPS range on the built-in cable, so it honestly wins the Samsung 45 W segment as well as the long-cable one. Caveat for both: neither holds 45 W (Anker falls to about 27 W after 13–16 min, INIU to about 29 W after about 6 min on a MacBook Pro 13 M1). The UGREEN that ChargerLAB tore down (PB603) is also 3 A PPS on the cable, but I could not tie PB603 to the US-store Nexode Pro listing, so do not print that as a fact about our $35.99 row until the model number is matched.
